all_found.desc: [BUG] mutateFinding imports only the single overridden finding ID from a committed log, so sibling blockers in that log stay unknown to the ledger, and pr-ready's lenient reconcileReview/ClassifyReviewFindings skips unknown IDs and treats the whole log as Resolved. Verified in a scratch clone: a committed-only task-done log with blockers -001 and -002; request+grant on -001 only makes pr-ready stop blocking without mentioning -002 — an unaddressed real blocker is silently cleared.

[BUG] The importer accepts a blocker only from the log whose own Run ID raised it, but pr-ready logs carry forward blockers raised by earlier runs whose own log was never committed. 3 of 273 committed blocking headings in this repo are such orphans (e.g. mrvf-20260926-213100487219000-pr-ready-branch-10d735e5-001 carried in an ESCALATED log); the gate blocks on them but override request/grant still says not found.

[ADVISORY] parseCommittedFinding reads Run ID and Target from anywhere in the file, not header-only first-match like reviewlog.parseMarkdown. A log without a header Run ID but with a body line 'Run ID: `x`' would take x as the raising run.
[ADVISORY] Three refusal cases use IDs whose heading never appears in the log, so they stop at !found and never reach raisedBy's numeric-index check. Weakening raisedBy would leave these tests green.

[ADVISORY] Imported rows carry target {type:review-log}, so sameRunTarget never matches and a --previous-run chain can never close an imported override-pending row as fixed. A pending imported override stays pending until granted even if later fixed.

[BUG] The import runs only when the requested ID has no ledger row, so once a finding was imported as a sibling, overriding it never imports the other blockers of a second committed log that also lists it. Reproduced: L1 lists R1-001 and R1-002, L2 lists its own R2-001 plus R1-001 carried forward. grant R1-002 imports L1's rows only; grant R1-001 is a ledger hit, nothing imported; pr-ready ignores unknown R2-001 and clears L2 though R2-001 was never addressed.

[BUG] A sibling that is pr-ready's own derived 'Unresolved review blockers' summary is imported with fingerprint imported-review-log:<id>, losing the pr:unresolved-review-blockers: prefix withoutOwnPRReadyFindings and supersedesUnreproducedSummary key on. Overriding the real blocker of a committed pr-ready log imports its summary as an open sibling that pr-ready never drops or supersedes, so it blocks pr-ready on itself until a second override.
[ADVISORY] 'the raising log wins' only orders the carrier first, so it cannot tell raising-log-wins from last-wins. A regression of the raisedHere guard to last-wins would pass.

findings.issue_text: [ADVISORY] Because the committed-log scan runs on every override, an override on a known finding can append open sibling rows that the CLI output never mentions. An operator sees only 'override granted' while pr-ready still blocks on newly imported rows, with nothing naming the extra IDs that need their own override.

[ADVISORY] The scan runs on every override and aborts it on any unreadable .md in docs/metareview/reviews or a HEAD read failure, even for a finding already in the ledger. An override on a known finding that used to work regardless of committed-log state now fails on an I/O or git error (fail closed). Not reproduced.

[ADVISORY] On a fresh clone, overriding a historical pr-ready summary ID imports every stale blocker its log lists as open rows. Extra request/grant pairs are needed; consistent with 'the log blocks anyway' but surprising when replaying historical overrides.

rejected.desc: [ADVISORY] handleOverride roots at the raw cwd (workdir) rather than the repository root, so the ledger and the committed-log import are looked up under <cwd>. override request from a subdirectory prints 'not found' for a committed-only blocker (pre-existing rooting, now reaching the import too).
[ADVISORY] One unreadable .md in docs/metareview/reviews aborts the whole scan instead of skipping it. An override on a finding in a later readable log fails with a read error. Rare.
[ADVISORY] committedReviewsDir duplicates the docs/metareview/reviews path and the dir-listing loop of reviewlog.Discover. If the directory moves, gates and importer disagree.
[ADVISORY] The diff also rewrites the pr-ready run-lineage sentence (mr-mrf clarification) unrelated to #188. No functional impact; bundled doc edit.

fix@0.summary: Import every blocking finding of each committed log that lists the ID (P1: one grant no longer retires a log's other blockers); accept carried-forward blockers with the run taken from the ID; header-only Run ID/Target/kind; a chain naming an imported row's run closes it; refusal tests reach the ID-format guards.
